scientific_integrity.claim_scope: Exactly one voter for every adjacent candidate pair on a path, uniformly sampled size-k committees; ordinary binary approval-count utilities; m>=4.
limitations: Not a theorem for arbitrary Candidate Interval profiles.
Does not claim an EJR+ characterization.
The Poisson approximation for rare runs is classical in related probability models.
scientific_integrity.proof_status: Analytic proof for all finite m,k and asymptotic regimes; code provides independent finite checks, not an infinite certificate.

title: A cubic-root Poisson threshold for fair and efficient interval committees
